title: 'Good Bad Ugly' box office collection day 8: Ajith's film surpasses 'Game Changer' collections; inches towards the 200 crore mark
summary: On its eighth day, Ajith's Tamil film 'Good Bad Ugly' continued strong theatrical run, reportedly surpassing the collections of 'Game Changer' and edging closer to the 200 crore milestone. Trade estimates point to sustained audience interest and favorable word-of-mouth as the film consolidates its box office position.
content:
On day eight of its theatrical run, Ajith's 'Good Bad Ugly' continued to post robust numbers at the box office, with trade estimates indicating that the film has now surpassed the collections of 'Game Changer'. Industry observers say the movie's momentum has been driven by strong opening territories and steady weekday hold, helping it inch closer to the widely reported 200 crore mark.

Audience response and word-of-mouth have been cited as key drivers of the film's sustained performance. Several regions that traditionally support Tamil cinema showed healthy occupancy patterns through the week, while multiplex centres noted continued interest from family and mass audiences alike. Exhibitors have highlighted positive footfall during evening shows and a series of sold-out screenings in select circuits.

Comparisons with 'Game Changer' have become a talking point among trade analysts, who monitor week-by-week performance and cumulative grosses to gauge longer-term prospects. While direct apples-to-apples comparisons can be affected by release patterns, screen counts and regional draws, the fact that 'Good Bad Ugly' has eclipsed 'Game Changer' in reported collections underscores its commercial strength so far.

Box office trackers caution that final totals will depend on upcoming weekend returns, overseas performance and the film's hold in smaller centres. Promotional activity, word-of-mouth continuity and absence of strong new competition will all play a role in whether the film can sustain its run and reach the 200 crore benchmark.

For now, producers and distributors are keeping a close eye on daily trends while fans and industry watchers celebrate the film's commercial trajectory. As figures consolidate over the coming days, clearer confirmation of milestones and final tallies is expected from official trade reports.
